solution:
Calculation:

Total exports of 2015 = 2000 + 4000 + 3000 = 9000

Total exports of 2016 = 1000 + 5000 + 2000 = 8000

Total exports of 2017 = 2000 + 4000 + 4000 = 10000

Total exports of 2018 = 3000 + 5000 + 4000 = 12000

Total exports of 2019 = 4000 + 3000 + 5000 = 12000

**∴ In the following years given in the options, 2019 has the highest total exports from the three companies together.**
